description: DES PoR Tool simulates patient processing and calculates space requirements for hospital planning. Its contributors publish a discrete-event model implemented in Python for Grasshopper, using SimPy within a parametric CAD workflow. Users specify doctor capacity, patient arrivals, treatment times and simulation settings, then compare throughput and waiting times with requirements for clinical units. The space calculations use hospital design standards. Coverage is a user-defined hospital scenario, with no fixed geographic domain or historical record; event timing follows the supplied arrivals and treatment processes. GitHub provides source code and a procedural overview under MIT, allowing free reuse of the tool. The SoftwareX metadata also lists Rhino and Grasshopper or a Jupyter workflow, alongside SimPy and NumPy. A limitation is that host-software access and chosen design standards must suit the intended application. The model can test how staffing and layout assumptions affect operational capacity. Related record model-patientflow predicts bed demand, serving a different hospital-planning task. No patient records were downloaded and no simulation was run.
